Name: More Unique Fish
Author: fercorn
Description:
[heading][b]Requirements[/b]
Before installing this mod, please make sure you have the latest versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b] installed.
The mod may not load correctly without the required dependencies.


About This Mod[/heading]
This mod adds [b]32 new fish species[/b] to Stardew Valley, bringing more variety and discoveries to fishing and collecting.
Each fish has its own custom pixel art and individually designed [b]locations, seasons, weather conditions, times, fishing level requirements, rarity, and catch difficulty[/b]. All new fish are integrated into the vanilla fishing system without replacing any existing fish.
All 32 fish support [b]fish tank display and Fish Ponds[/b], with some special species featuring unique pond water colors.
The mod is available in [b]English and Simplified Chinese[/b].
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]32 new catchable fish[/b][/*]
[*]Custom pixel art for every species[/*]
[*]Different locations, seasons, weather conditions, and times[/*]
[*]Individually designed rarity, fishing level requirements, and catch difficulty[/*]
[*]Full fish tank support[/*]
[*]Fish Pond support for all 32 species[/*]
[*]Unique Fish Pond water colors for selected species[/*]
[*]Keeps all vanilla fish and the vanilla fishing system intact[/*]
[*]Available in English and Simplified Chinese[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and the required dependencies listed below.[/*]
[*]Download the version for your preferred language.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Do not install the English and Simplified Chinese versions at the same time.[/b]
When updating the mod, it is recommended to remove the previous version before installing the new one.

[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
This mod adds new fish without replacing any vanilla fish.
If you encounter a conflict with another mod, please report the name of the mod and describe the issue.
[heading]Bug Reports[/heading]
If you encounter any of the following issues, feel free to report them on the Nexus Mods page:
[list]
[*]A fish cannot be caught[/*]
[*]Fishing conditions do not match the description[/*]
[*]Incorrect fish tank sprites[/*]
[*]Fish Pond issues[/*]
[*]Translation or text errors[/*]
[*]Any other suspected bugs[/*]
[/list]If possible, please include your [b]SMAPI log, game version, and relevant installed mods[/b]. This will make troubleshooting much easier.
[heading]Future Updates[/heading]
The current version includes [b]32 new fish[/b].
If the mod receives positive feedback or players would like to see more content, additional fish may be added in future updates, along with further improvements to the existing content.
[heading]Support[/heading]
This mod is completely free to download and use.
If you enjoy the mod, feedback, comments, and bug reports are always appreciated.
